title: Story premise EDU058: The Assumption Under the Floor
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: What is this estimate standing on? Takeaway/theme: An estimate is easier to evaluate when its key assumptions are visible.
description: A planner wants to compare two production routes, but one estimate silently assumes existing voice recordings. Pulling up the floorboard reveals the assumption and recalculating both routes makes the comparison usable.
